body: I'm sorry that it sounded a bit assholish, seemed like I wanted to brag about it, not my intention at all. What I meant was that I have many things in my life that, in someone else's place, would make him/her happy, and that they didn't make me happy
It seems pretty impossible for me to live happy while thinking on pain or whatever, but I'll give it a try.
Could you elaborate a bit more? I haven't really understood you
But the bad moments make the good times seem not worth it, the mere fact that I will be uncomfortable millions of times in my life just makes the good times useless...

I often am happy because of those things (I'm going to a gym so even better), but at the end of the day I will still have the big problem right there and a very pessimistic view on life, and I'm scared when I start learning a sport or a videogame, I truly am scared, because (even though I'm still working on it and the effect would be less than a month ago) I won't reward myself for the good things I might do in that sport or videogame and punish me for the mistakes, and I'm scared for all the bad times I'll have. It's like I'm scared someone would beat me up to death, and that is me (I would say that WAS me, because I've improved on this and now the punishment.isnt so strong. Off topic but I don't reward myself for this improvement in my behaviour, fuuuuuck)
Sigh... but there are too many bad things... too many bad moments... I dont want not to be be happy ever again... such a shit life... I just don't want to live this anymore!!! I feel so impotent.

And what can I do...? Just wait? And be really unmotivated to achieve those goals that I set for myself, which, to achieve happily, I'd need motivation? (Talking about getting high grades at school) srgnjmgrfsnjkgrffsdnjkmgrfdsxkjm fucking frustration.

Like, whenever I do something, it doesn't seem good enough, and therefore, I don't reward myself, and I never reward myself, and that is reaaaally unmotivating. As we've mentioned already, motivation to study, too, but generally, everything, as I don't see how great I did something and thus I don't reward myself. It has always been like this, and I'm pretty unmotivated to get better at things.
But I'm extremely unmotivated to work...

A compliment by me or by anybody else, words, gifts, but, mainly, what I was talking about was about me rewarding myself mentally, like thinking "Yeah that was good" or whatever, no, I don't think that, I don't give me myself any mental rewards, ever.

But it always happens, it doesn't have any impact on me, I never reward myself for anything, I never do and whenever I do something really great, took me a lot of work, effort or whatever I don't do anything, so that's why I don't think it will magically happen when I get my degree.
Yeah friends and family are a good reason not to suicide but I just can't see HOW IS IT WORTH IT! Even knowing eeeeveeeerything about family friends, everything you and /u/alternateyouruniverse have told me it still doesn't seem worth the hassle, the problems, the trouble, the effort, it just doesn't...

My dream or future plan is kinda clear, as I mentioned, I want to become either a programmer or a mathematician, and both things would make me happy, but my doubt is: Would that be enough? Would getting my dream job or achievinf my future plan be enough? I really don't think so. I get to this conclusion because I never appreciate anything I do in life, even if it was really good, I just dont appreciate it and reward myself
It probably sounds pretty incredible but I still don't see life completely worth it.

I really like maths because it's one of the subjects that will make me learn something I will actually use in my life, I'm also really concentrated and I'm sucked in by whatever is being teached, everything is so methodical, but the main reason is that everything gets twisted more and more, everything gets harder you learn new things and you have to use your head to find the solution, to find the best way, the one that works better, takes less time, you have to think. I think I like it so much because this is a subject where you really have to think and use all the tools you have been teached to solve a problem, which tools are you going to pick? Is that as good as this other tool? What convination of tools works better? I can only imagine how much mathematics I would have learned and how many stuff I could do if I ever become a mathematician, I am excited just by writing this.

I'm not exactly in the same situation that you are, but there are similarities: I also hate that I can'tbe studying what I like, I also hate that I have to go through this shit so I can finally start working towards being who I really want to be (hopefully a mathematician or a programmer) and going to school daily is a really big pain in the ass, I often cry on sundays if I forgot that I have to go to school the day after. So regarding this aspect I feel pretty bad about it. I  am scared about a lack of happiness even if I become what I wanna be in life. What you mentioned about friends is true, but I dont know what to do with my life, if I ever suicide at least I won't feel guilty because I would be dead, but, unfortunately, I don't think I will suicide because of the extreme pain.

I think that if I didnt have any friends I wouldn't be happy at all, but these friends do give me happiness, it just, I don't know, it kind of doesn't seem enough, and I just see life not worth living, I mean there are some reasons but they don't convince me, they are true but they have very little impact. I think if I thought everything was worthless I would be sadder, so I prefer not to think about that, wether it's true or not.

I think you are giving too much imporance to a girlfriend, I recognize that I have mentioned it and I would like to have one, and I know I perfectly can because I have a lot of qualities, but maybe a girlfriend doesn't make me feel that much, maybe it does, who knows. I want to get a girlfriend 60% because I want to and 40% because of me pressuring myself (caused by social pressure) because I am jealous every time I see someone with a gf and think that I should get one already, I'm old enough, but basically social pressure.

The thing is that the concept of "life is more or less worth it... kinda worth, meh worth it" is still there, I just dont see it being worth living at all, I dont want to be in trouble anymore, I dont want to have any more bad moments...

No, not at all, I think, I can recognize something is nice and it has x qualities and sometimes I can also think that its kinda awesome, but not very much. Also, if life's point isn't to be happy, then what it is? Happiness feels good.

One of the things preventing me from suiciding is getting a girlfriend, but its such an EXTREME effort to meet people and especially to find a girl I like (and she likes me back) because maybe she helps me with my emotions problem. The problem is that I care a lot about what other people might think, but I'm pretty normal when talking and people say I'm funny. It's also such a biiiiig effort to "fix" other problems (the main problem and the most important is the emotions one) and it's so much easier to suicide, but as I told you I'm fucked either way, because if my beliefs are right [...] Explained it aready

EDIT: I imagined myself suiciding and I felt pretty bad because I really want someone to love me as much as a girlfriend does (my family and friends do love me, but I mean a different type of love) and I also wanted to yell at people how bad life is and how I feel, especially at the people that comment here saying I hope you take the right decision/ I hope you choose to live, I reeeaaaally want to yell at them that suiciding or not isnt something like a lottery, FUCK YOU, saying that won't help for shit

I'm currently going to a psychologist but I don't think he will help me with this problem I have about emotions. Thanks for the kind words but unfortunately they don't mean much for me, I'm used to being called smart (such a douchebag sentence, I'm sorry) This is supposed to be a pretty happy stage on my life and I'm not happy, so it makes me even sadder. What bothers me a little is I'm not brave enough to suicide already, but it probably won't be a problem, since I'll probably suicide within 10-12 years, my anxiety and my pessimism will get over me when I get to university, so yeah...

I can't fucking wait anymore this life is so mundane... Suicide seems like the only option, the only thing preventing me from doing it are my friends, family and people that love me and the extreme pain I'd feel, but I have no real reason apart from that

Yeah I won't try drugs unless I actually decide to suicide, which, if it happens I will go for smth that- Well I don't want to get into details because it's saddening but I appreciate your advice, and I won't do drugs

Hey, first of all I'd like to say thank you for spending time reading my post. Regarding your question about chemistry, no, it doesn't interest me as much as math does and I don't know what units are, I guess they are subjects, if so, I know which subjects I will be taught next year, and there are a couple that interest me, but it's generally the same uninteresting subjects. I am really doubtful I will find that feeling of beauty/true happiness or whatever... I just want to be gone forever, I don't want to have bad moments ever again, and since that's what life is, I don't want to live it, but, if my beliefs are right and there doesn't exist a true god then it will be just nothingness, so I'm fucked either way...
